about_the_game:
Step into the role of an operator in a retro-futuristic dystopia, where a screen displays the world under constant surveillance. With moral dilemmas similar to Papers, Please and subtle hints of Pony Island’s unsettling atmosphere, Monitor State puts you in control of a surveillance system, watching citizens, enforcing laws, and uncovering a web of secrets that could change everything.

              

A Living, Breathing World

  • Gripping Storyline: Dive into a detailed dystopian world where each case reveals hidden stories, drawing you into a thrilling plot.

  • Diverse Incidents: From street clashes to suspicious behavior, the system logs every event, demanding your attention and decisions.

  • Evolving Laws: Rules shift with the times, challenging you to adapt your approach to each case.

  • Echoes of Your Choices: Every decision leaves subtle traces, hinting at consequences that could reshape the world.

Your Burden, Your Power

Dossiers reveal names, histories, and secrets, leaving you to decide: arrest, fine, or ignore violations. Each choice carries weight, watched closely by a distant department that scrutinizes your every move. The system evolves, and so must you, navigating a web of consequences in a world where right and wrong blur into shades of gray.

Stay Connected

Monitor State is a work in progress. Add it to your wishlist to get notified about the release and join our Discord for updates!
